defs.def: a feeling of great pleasure 高兴；愉快；快乐

ex.s: Paul Beer, head of rhino section at Port Lympne, said: “Obviously we're all absolutely delighted to welcome another calf to our black rhino family.
ex.t: 波特·林普恩犀牛部门主管保罗·比尔说："显然我们都非常高兴欢迎另一头小犀牛加入我们的黑犀牛家族。

ex.s: Match the headings to the sections and I would be delighted to have the opportunity to discuss my application further with you.
ex.t: 将标题与部分匹配，我很乐意有机会与您进一步讨论我的申请。

ex.s: I would be delighted to have the opportunity to discuss my application further with you.
ex.t: 我很高兴有机会与您进一步讨论我的申请。

ex.s: When life seems like one long night,And nothing is ever going right,There's just one sure delight:Friendship, like sunrise, warm and bright.
ex.t: 当生活漫长得像一个无尽的夜晚，一切似乎都永远不对劲，只有一种快乐是确定的：友谊，像日出一样，温暖而明亮。

defs.def: something that gives you great pleasure 令人高兴的事；乐事；乐趣

ex.s: If a strange family showed up on her front doorstep, Mom would have been delighted.
ex.t: 如果有一户陌生人家出现在她家门口，妈妈本会很高兴的。

ex.s: He also saw hundreds of delighted students who had turned out to welcome him.
ex.t: 他还看到数百名高兴的学生前来欢迎他。

ex.s: Thank you for your time and consideration.I would be delighted to have the opportunity to discuss my application further with you.
ex.t: 感谢您的时间和考虑。我很乐意有机会与您进一步讨论我的申请。
